summary.en: US equities face a tech-led recovery attempt after Tuesday's losses. CoreWeave reported revenue growth of 168% and a path to profitability in H1 2028, while Goldman Sachs added a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after the October inflation report. Nasdaq-100 futures are up 1.94% and S&P 500 futures 0.98% versus the previous US cash close, but a 0.52% stronger dollar highlights the tension between AI optimism and tighter policy expectations. US stock markets are open on Veterans Day; the 4.983% Treasury yield is a previous bond-session reference during the fixed-income holiday.
summary.zh: 美股在周二下跌后迎来科技股带动的修复尝试。CoreWeave报告营收增长168%，并给出2028年上半年实现盈利的展望；高盛则在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储利率展望。纳斯达克100期货较前一美股现金收盘上涨1.94%，标普500期货上涨0.98%，但美元指数走强0.52%，显示AI乐观预期与政策收紧预期之间仍有拉锯。退伍军人节当天美股照常交易；债市假日期间，4.983%的美债收益率仅作为前一债市交易日参考。

title.en: Goldman adds a March 25bp Fed hike to its outlook after October inflation data
title.zh: 高盛在10月通胀数据公布后，将3月加息25个基点纳入美联储展望

impact.en: A longer expected tightening cycle could pressure valuations, particularly for growth and AI stocks. The report cites CME FedWatch odds of 13.5% for a 50bp December hike, up from effectively zero before the inflation data. Goldman expects inflation to ease through year-end before renewed price pressures make a March increase more likely than a January move.
impact.zh: 更长的预期紧缩周期可能压制估值，尤其是成长股和AI股票。报道援引CME FedWatch数据，12月加息50个基点的概率为13.5%，而通胀数据公布前接近零。高盛预计通胀在年底前放缓，但年初价格压力再现，使3月加息比1月行动更可能发生。

bearish: 更长的加息周期可能压制股票估值 / A longer expected hiking cycle could pressure equity valuations
12月加息50个基点的概率升至13.5% / Reported odds of a 50bp December hike rose to 13.5%

macroRisk.en: Goldman now projects rate cuts no earlier than December 2027, three months later than previously forecast, followed by cuts in March, June and September 2028.
macroRisk.zh: 高盛将首次降息预期推迟至2027年12月（较此前推迟三个月），随后2028年3月、6月、9月各降一次。

title.en: CoreWeave revenue grows 168%; shares rise 8% in extended trading after a roughly 40% slide over the past month
title.zh: CoreWeave营收增长168%；盘后股价上涨8%，此前过去一个月累计下跌约40%

impact.en: The revenue growth and H1 2028 profitability outlook provide support for the AI-demand narrative, without establishing that the capital-spending cycle is risk-free. Reuters also reports that Nvidia's selloff steadied after a $430B loss in market value over two days, while SoftBank narrowed its early share decline after reporting a $7B second-quarter loss tied to US data-center costs.
impact.zh: 营收增长和2028年上半年的盈利展望为AI需求叙事提供支撑，但并不能说明资本开支周期没有风险。路透社还报道，英伟达在两日市值蒸发$430B后跌势趋稳；软银在公布与美国数据中心成本相关的$7B第二季度亏损后，早盘股价跌幅收窄。

bullish: 168%的营收增长为AI需求叙事提供支撑 / Reported revenue growth of 168% supports the AI-demand narrative
来源报道纳指期货和亚洲科技股走强 / The source reports firmer Nasdaq futures and Asian technology shares

macroRisk.en: Nvidia's $430B two-day loss in market value and SoftBank's $7B quarterly loss highlight the scale of capital commitments and execution risk in the AI buildout.
macroRisk.zh: 英伟达两日市值蒸发$430B，以及软银$7B季度亏损，凸显AI建设周期中资本投入的规模和执行风险。

title.en: European bourses higher midday as tech and oil lead; US futures rally on AI earnings
title.zh: 欧洲股市午盘走高，科技和石油领涨；美股期货受AI财报提振反弹

impact.en: European sector performance is uneven: the technology index was up 2% and oil and gas 2.4%, while banks and food and beverage each fell 0.3% in the cited midday report. These moves show sector divergence; they do not establish investor motives. The stronger dollar and longer expected Fed tightening cycle may limit sustained equity gains.
impact.zh: 所引欧洲午盘报道显示板块表现分化：科技指数上涨2%，石油天然气上涨2.4%，而银行及食品饮料各下跌0.3%。这些变动体现板块分化，并不能确定投资者的动机。美元走强以及更长的预期美联储紧缩周期，可能限制股市持续上涨。

bearish: 美元走强和收紧政策预期可能限制修复 / Dollar strength and tighter-policy expectations may limit the recovery

macroRisk.en: Brent crude up 1.6% at $92.91/barrel in midday European trades; the cause of the oil move is not confirmed in the sources.

ai.en: CoreWeave's 168% revenue growth and H1 2028 profitability path provided a concrete demand signal; European tech index up 2% and NQ futures +1.94% versus prior close reflect the bid. Nvidia's $430B two-day loss steadied but the AI-bubble debate remains unresolved.
ai.zh: CoreWeave营收增长168%及2028年上半年盈利展望提供了AI需求信号；欧洲科技指数上涨2%、纳斯达克100期货较前一收盘上涨1.94%。英伟达在两日市值蒸发$430B后跌势趋稳，但AI投资风险仍受关注。

semiconductor.en: SOXX was down 0.22% in the prior session; the CoreWeave result and Nvidia stabilization provided a partial offset, but the sector remains sensitive to the extended Fed tightening cycle.
semiconductor.zh: SOXX前一交易日下跌0.22%；CoreWeave业绩和英伟达企稳提供部分对冲，但板块仍对延长紧缩周期敏感。

bigTech.en: Reuters reports that Nvidia's selloff steadied after a $430B two-day loss in market value. SoftBank reported a $7B Q2 loss tied to US data-center costs, highlighting the capital intensity of AI infrastructure.
bigTech.zh: 路透社报道，英伟达在两日市值蒸发$430B后跌势趋稳。软银报告与美国数据中心成本相关的$7B第二季度亏损，凸显AI基础设施的资本密集特征。

keyRisk.en: 25bp December Fed hike fully priced; 50bp tail risk at 13.5%. Goldman projects cuts no earlier than December 2027.
keyRisk.zh: 12月25个基点加息已完全定价；50个基点尾部风险13.5%。高盛预计最早2027年12月降息。

note.en: The main tension is between an AI earnings rebound and a longer expected Fed tightening cycle. CoreWeave's reported 168% revenue growth and H1 2028 profitability outlook support the demand narrative, while Nasdaq-100 futures up 1.94% and S&P 500 futures up 0.98% versus the previous cash close suggest an attempted repair. The dollar's 0.52% rise and reported 13.5% odds of a 50bp December hike provide contrary signals; the 4.983% Treasury yield is a prior bond-session reference during today's bond holiday. I lean toward a fragile tech-led recovery, with medium confidence because demand optimism does not remove rate uncertainty. For today's equity open, watch whether gains broaden into cash semiconductor shares and whether dollar strength moderates; narrowing breadth or a firmer dollar would weaken the repair view.
note.zh: 核心矛盾是AI财报带动的反弹与更长的预期美联储紧缩周期之间的拉锯。CoreWeave报告营收增长168%，并给出2028年上半年盈利展望，为需求叙事提供支撑；纳斯达克100期货和标普500期货较前一现金收盘分别上涨1.94%和0.98%，显示修复尝试。相反信号来自美元指数上涨0.52%，以及报道中的12月加息50个基点概率升至13.5%；债市假日期间，4.983%的美债收益率仅是前一债市交易日参考。我倾向于认为这是脆弱的科技股修复，保持中等置信度，因为需求乐观预期并未消除利率不确定性。关注今天美股开盘后涨势能否扩散至半导体现货股票，以及美元强势是否缓和；若市场广度收窄或美元继续走强，修复判断将削弱。
